Pilbara Bakehouse specializes in fresh baked sourdough production while respecting traditional principles of artisan daily baking.

We are seeking for qualified Pastrycooks / Bakers who passionate, enthusiastic, and responsible individuals.

Tasks and duties include the following:

* Preparing cakes, pastries, desserts, and pastry fillings.
* Checking the cleanliness of equipment and operation of premises before & after production runs to ensure compliance with occupational health and safety regulations.
* Checking the quality of raw materials and weighing ingredients to ensure there is no contamination or foreign objects.
* Kneading, maturing, cutting, molding, mixing and shaping dough and pastry goods.
* Monitoring oven temperatures and product appearance to determine baking times.
* Coordinating the forming, loading, baking, unloading, de-panning and cooling of batches of bread, rolls and pastry products.
* Glazing buns and pastries, and decorating cakes with cream and icing.
* Operating machines which roll and mould dough and cut biscuits.
* Emptying, cleaning and greasing baking trays, tins and other cooking equipment.
* Create new and exciting desserts to renew menus and engage the interest of customers.

Desirable qualifications and skills include:

* Relevant trade qualification or equivalent is a minimum requirement.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Pastry Cook / Bakers or Pastry Chef.
* Strong skills in the production of pastries, desserts and cakes – preferred.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to multi-task.
* Ability to work effectively and efficiently in a team environment.
* Have sound knowledge on all Pastry and bakery equipment including mixing and ovens.
* Strong work ethic and great attention to detail and creativity.
* Strong organizing and leadership skills.

Salary range: $80,000 – $90,000 per year

If you meet the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we would love to hear from you! Please contact us directly for more information or to apply for this position.

Royal Prince Alfred Hospital

What you'll be doing
The Medical Informatics JMO position:

Is a full-time (1.0 FTE - 38 hours per week) role which provides medical informatics expertise and support to all hospitals and health services within SLHD.

The role is physically based across both Royal Prince Alfred and Concord Hospitals (approximately 50% time will be spent at each), however includes Balmain Hospital, Canterbury Hospitals and other health services where required.

Integrates clinical expertise with computer and information sciences to advise on clinical information systems development; supports the medical workforce in utilising these systems safely and productively including delivering training; and drives adoption and effective translation of clinical practice within these systems.

Facilitates the integration of evidence, research, health information analytics, clinical best practice, and industry knowledge of successful implementations to support patients, clinicians and other providers in their use of the electronic medical record (eMR) and other clinical information systems.

Is an accredited training post for the Royal Australasian College of Medical Administration (RACMA) Fellowship Training Program, however existing candidacy is not a prerequisite for selection.

Sydney Local Health District's vision incorporates NSW Health Core Values and a commitment to equity, health improvement, timeliness and efficiency, recognising that evidence-based service delivery requires highly skilled and valued staff supported by research, education and state-of-the-art technologies. 
 
Our strategic priority under this vision is our commitment to excellence in Patient and Family Centre Care. Staff are supported to ensure patients, their families and carers are considered as partners in care to achieve optimal patient outcomes and best possible healthcare experience. 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

MBBS or equivalent, currently registered with the Medical Board of Australia.

At least two years' recent experience working as a medical practitioner in Australia.

Demonstrated experience and expertise to practise as a Junior Medical Officer in medical informatics including relevant research and current (or working toward) higher qualification e.g. Master of Health Management, Master of Digital Health, CHIA Digital Health Certification.

Current or previous clinical experience with digital clinical information systems including Cerner Millenium, Epic Systems, electronic Medications Management, and virtual models of care.

Previous experience with health informatics implementations, delivering related training, and demonstrated understanding of the issues relating to clinical information systems.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact and influence effectively, develop productive working relationships with a wide range of individuals and interest groups, and prepare high-quality briefing documents and presentations.

Demonstrated strong analytical and organisational skills and the ability to work independently and in a team as required.

Demonstrated understanding of change management and clinical redesign processes.
